title: Automation, extension and API surface
objective: Extend the verified CAD/BIM product with a bounded, deterministic automation and extension/API surface for scripting, integrations and controlled third-party extensions while preserving ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1, Construction Graph authority, existing CAD/BIM semantics and Web/Electron parity.
acceptance_criteria: Automation requests use versioned typed contracts and deterministic command/query semantics.
Automation cannot mutate canonical state except through the existing governed App API/domain transaction path.
Extension code cannot import or bypass protected engine/renderer/domain boundaries.
Unsupported capabilities return explicit typed failures; no fabricated semantics.
Script/workflow execution is reproducible for identical canonical inputs and declared environment/profile.
Canonical revision/event identity remains authoritative and revision-bound in automation results.
Event/subscription delivery is bounded, ordered and explicitly scoped; no hidden background authority is introduced.
Web and Electron expose identical semantic automation/extension behavior.
Existing CAD-PARITY-002..016 and compatibility baselines remain green and byte-identical unless an explicitly reviewed migration is required.
Exact final head is CI-verified, deployment/browser/Electron verified where applicable, and revision-bound before merge.
No protected architecture paths are modified; architecture changes require an ACR.
non_goals: Unbounded plugin ecosystems or arbitrary native-code execution.
Replacing the App API, Construction Graph, CADDocument, renderer or engine-adapter boundaries.
Cloud-scale orchestration beyond the bounded durable job mechanism already established in P016.
Autonomous agents with unrestricted write access.
Proprietary vendor API compatibility unless separately scoped and approved.
risk_assumptions: CAD-PARITY-016 is VERIFIED and is the required predecessor baseline before P017 implementation.
Construction Graph remains authoritative and CADDocument remains the editor representation.
Architecture v1.1 remains frozen throughout P017.
Existing engine, worker, persistence and durable-job boundaries remain available and authoritative as defined by prior verified work.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic automation/script fixtures with replay/reproducibility assertions.
Authorization and boundary tests proving automation cannot bypass canonical mutation paths.
Event ordering/subscription and durable-job integration tests where applicable.
Regression proof that CAD-PARITY-002..016 and compatibility baselines remain green and byte-identical.
Exact-head deployment plus real-browser/Electron evidence where applicable.
Revision-bound governance evidence covering implementation, merge and post-merge verification.

transitions.reason: Dependency CAD-PARITY-016 is formally VERIFIED against mainline merge revision c06df768365c706cae3483fc927d25bfdee63a80; release P017 from dependency lock under frozen Architecture v1.1.

Authorize CAD-PARITY-017 implementation to the logical implementation agent. Implementation must stop at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING for Architect review; merge, approval and verification remain Architect-owned gates.

Implementation begins for CAD-PARITY-017 from the verified CAD-PARITY-016 mainline baseline (merge c06df768365c706cae3483fc927d25bfdee63a80, baseline db94043). Scope is the bounded automation, extension and API surface slice defined by Issue #116 — versioned typed automation contracts over the governed App API, deterministic script/workflow execution with reproducible fixtures, capability discovery with typed unsupported-operation results, manifest-based extensions that cannot bypass protected boundaries, a bounded ordered scoped event/subscription surface derived from canonical revision records, authorization hooks reusing the existing role/ability model, and bounded durable-job integration — preserving Construction Graph authority, frozen Architecture v1.1, the byte-identical CAD-PARITY-002..016 and compatibility baselines, and the PR_OPEN/VERIFYING stop gate.

Implementation complete and submitted as PR #117: the bounded automation/extension/API surface — the versioned typed capability registry (41 governed App API capabilities, API-001), the manifest-based scripts/extensions (DATA ONLY), the deterministic governed execution with the reproducible outcome digest, the reused P016 role/ability authorization hook, the bounded scoped derived event feed and the script-driven durable job integration — with the app-suite, smoke+fixture and restart-proof evidence.

Submitted PR #117 for Architect review: the exact-head CI binding (the dedicated cad-parity-017 dispatch run + the full matrix), the exact-head deployment plus real-browser evidence and the regression matrix will be recorded as additional evidence per the P016 discipline.

Independent Architect review completed against the exact implementation head b4ddd3ef2c218e273d6b83e855edb97ddba7506d. The evidence package is complete: terminal exact-head CI and dedicated P017 dispatch are green, the SHA-bound preview deployment and deployed smoke are green, restart durability and deterministic replay are proven, Web/Electron semantic parity and engine-isolation checks are green, and the direct real-browser verification was re-run with zero console/page errors and durable state across reload. No protected architecture artifact changed and no ACR is required.
Architect decision APPROVED recorded after exact-head review. Merge is authorized for PR #117 at the reviewed implementation head; VERIFIED remains a separate post-merge Architect gate.

evidence.description: The full app suite at the P1/P2/P3 heads: 1267 tests, 1226 pass, 0 fail, 41 skipped (1207 pre-P017 baseline + 20 new CAD-PARITY-017 tests: automation-p017.test.ts and automation-p017-host-parity.test.ts). The pre-existing CAD-PARITY-002..016 baselines remain green and pinned fixtures byte-identical.
evidence.reproduction: cd app && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts (working directory app)

evidence.description: The automation-p017 web smoke exercises capability discovery, authorization, typed declines, deterministic script execution, reproducibility digest, bounded events, durable job integration, DATA-only extensions, shared persistence and save/open round-trip; the pinned fixture is byte-identical across repeat runs and the memory and real PostgreSQL backends.
evidence.reproduction: cd apps/web && node --import tsx test/automation-p017-smoke.mjs (apps/web, against the dev server; OFFISOS_WEB_URL)

evidence.description: The automation-p017 PROCESS-RESTART durability proof kills the whole dev-server process tree mid-flow and a fresh postgres-backed process recovers principals/scripts/runs/subscriptions/extensions and re-executes with the same reproducible digest across the process boundary.
evidence.reproduction: cd apps/web && node --import tsx test/automation-p017-restart-proof.mjs (requires DATABASE_URL)

decisions.rationale: P017 API-001 implementation is bounded, deterministic, authorization-checked and routed exclusively through the governed App API; extensions are DATA ONLY; event delivery is derived, bounded and non-authoritative; durable persistence and restart recovery reuse the P016 boundary; Web/Electron semantic parity and exact-head CI/deployment/browser evidence are complete; no protected architecture artifact changed and no ACR is required.
